en.advice.anongated: the upstream refused the anonymous request at the time; a key raises the quota but is not guaranteed to lift the refusal
en.advice.badkey: check that the key is correct
en.advice.keyhint: a key raises the quota; it does not change the model list
en.advice.quota: quota or rate limit hit — retry later
en.cardDesc: Choose which models appear in the model picker
en.empty: No models are available right now.
en.fallback: Showing the built-in fallback catalogue; it is not synced with models.dev yet.
en.hint: Hidden models disappear from the model picker; turn them back on to restore.
en.loadFailed: Could not load the model catalogue — the host did not answer.
en.marker.nosession: upstream answered MissingSessionID (the request carried no session id)
en.marker.opencodeonly: upstream says only the OpenCode client may send this
en.probeFailed: The probe request failed; visibility is unchanged. You can retry.
en.probeUntrusted: Some models could not be measured this round (upstream throttling, the anonymous tier refusing, or a network error); those models keep their current visibility.
en.probing.notModelFault: that was the upstream's answer at the time, not a verdict on the model
en.probing.roundRefused: These models could not be measured this round
en.title: Model visibility
en.unknownFree: Models Zen serves on the free tier that models.dev carries no metadata for:
en.unknownFreeWhy: their context length and capabilities are not knowable, and we have not verified that they answer on either channel this plugin uses, so they are not offered; this does not affect any row below.
